finish_message: Accurate line-level PDF highlights, multiline card-title editing, and MindMap card hit-test boundary fixes are complete and pushed.
summary: Imported and persisted MarginNote ZHIGHLIGHTS line rectangles, corrected imported MarginNote page numbers from 1-based to PDFKit 0-based indexing, added PDFKit line-selection fallback highlighting, matched annotations to each card's theme color with active-card emphasis, made card titles multiline while preserving newlines, aligned TreeLayout/CardNode/MindMap gesture geometry to the visible 220x120 card bounds, and added persistence/PDF highlight resolver tests.
notes: The implementation targets macOS PDFKit/AppKit/SwiftUI. The available execution environment here does not provide the macOS SDK, so swift test and swift build were not executed locally; the orchestrator should run both validation commands on macOS.
